blocks.text: Port Guichon Homes for Sale | Ladner BC

parts.t: Port Guichon is among the older neighbourhoods of Ladner, sitting along the Fraser River. You'll find character homes and quiet streets here, and some parts have river views. Homes range between updated family homes and older heritage-style houses, a lot of them close to the water or on older, settled streets. Walking paths follow the river and parks are nearby. Shops, restaurants and services are a few minutes away in Ladner’s village centre. Browse the Port Guichon homes for sale below and get in touch with me with any questions.

Port Guichon is Ladner's old riverside neighbourhood, with roots as a fishing village. It has family homes near the edge of the Fraser River, and Ladner Village is close by. There are still working port and industrial areas nearby from the area's past, but the homes here are about living by the river. See all
